text:
River,

There's a particular way you hold a book — thumb pressed flat against the spine, your whole hand wrapped around it like you're keeping it from escaping. I've been thinking about this instead of doing anything productive, which is essentially my brand at this point.

Unrelated: did you know that honey never spoils? Archaeologists found 3,000-year-old honey in Egyptian tombs and it was still perfectly edible. Something about the low moisture content and natural acidity creating an environment where bacteria simply can't survive. I find this unreasonably comforting — the idea that sweetness, properly kept, is essentially permanent.

I want to take you to Greece next summer. My father's village. I want to watch you eat loukoumades on the harbour wall with powdered sugar on your chin and pretend I'm not completely ruined by it.

I love you. Permanently, if you'll let me.

Gale
